snippet.title: Magnecube trailer
snippet.description:
The trailer for the puzzle game Magnecube made by ECS (Eternal CODE Studio)

🎮 ABOUT THE GAME
Magnecube is a 2D puzzle game based on magnet physics, where attraction, repulsion, timing, and precision are key to solving each level.

Stuck on a level in Story Mode? Don’t worry, you can "cheat" a little and watch the solution here
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BTDcK0YdTAw

🔗 DOWNLOAD MAGNECUBE
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3737600
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ECS.Magnecube
